title: Card labels: category, sub-category and complexity
text: Cards can now hold a category, a sub-category and a complexity (1, 2, 3, 5 or 8) next to their priority. Obeya can suggest labels a card doesn't have yet, and marks them as suggestions. It never overwrites a label the owner set, and once the owner clears a label, Obeya doesn't suggest it again. The labels belong to the owner: they're stored in Obeya, not in plan docs, and agents aren't told about them.
